design_rationale: DOE v2 identified [0, +2, -2] mm as the only residual above the fixed 0.50 lift-contact gate (0.50139), while its 79.15 mm lift missed the fixed 80 mm gate. Contract v3 rejected stage-constant residual application because contact fell to 0.4375-0.45. This paired follow-up restores the physically superior smooth residual schedule and varies only common lift height by 2 or 3 mm.

episodes.task_text: Recover cooperative cradle contact and transport the large rectangular carton to the marked destination.

admission_policy: Only complete physical successes with lift and transport cradle-contact ratios at or above 0.50, lift delta at or above 0.08 m, and all force gates satisfied enter PI0.5 training.
claim_boundary: Development-only paired follow-up; not an independent robustness estimate and not part of the frozen 105-episode evaluation.
